intro.text: The Wandersail's pet skyeel, which the crew finds dead just as Rysn prepares to take the ship on an expedition.
A pet skyeel kept by the crew of the Wandersail, well liked for hunting the ship's rats.

items.text: Screech was found dead during the voyage to Akinah. The superstitious crew took it as a bad omen, but sailed on because their orders came from Queen Fen.
Nikli had killed Screech with blackbane to frighten the crew into turning back, then tried to blame Cord, but Rysn worked out that he was the culprit.
